payload.title: E1 One identity check and one authorize per request
payload.description: Today each /graphql, /runs/ and /api/runs/{id}/events request resolves the session twice: the HTTP middleware (web_api.py:533-540 -> account_routes.py:79-82 _session with verify_person -> identities/me) and again in AccountAuthorization.on_execute (web_api.py:442-447) and the events route (account_routes.py:341-342), then authorize (prospectus_accounts.py:234-242). Three sequential Prospectus calls, ~4.5 s. Change: resolve the session once in the middleware, keep it on request.state, reuse it in AccountAuthorization, events and timeline; run identities/me and authorize concurrently. Authorization still checked every request (no cached grant). Acceptance: spec 'one identities/me and one authorize per graphql, events and timeline request' with a fake Prospectus counting calls; existing auth specs unchanged; revoked membership still refused on the next request.
